title: Zesty Egyptian Beet Soup
description: A fermented, fluffy soup that blends sweet beets with zesty lemon and creamy tahini for a nourishing, macrobiotic-friendly meal.
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C and roast beets for 35 minutes until tender.
Let beets cool, peel, and dice into cubes.
In a stockpot combine vegetable stock, diced beets, and bay leaf, and bring to a simmer.
Add minced garlic and cook for 5 minutes to infuse flavor.
Stir in fermented tahini, coconut milk, and olive oil until the soup thickens to a creamy consistency.
Season with cumin, coriander, salt, and pepper, and let simmer for 10 minutes.
Remove bay leaf and blend the soup with a hand blender until smooth and fluffy.
Stir in lemon juice and adjust seasoning if needed.
Ladle soup into bowls and garnish with fresh parsley or chopped cilantro.
Serve hot with a side of sautéed greens or whole grain bread.
